arguments.title: Comgu resolution: NH-BREW-PRO commerce parity (08b4644c)
arguments.content:
Comgu run `08b4644c4f5e47819c886cc1b5231e08` resolved 6 commerce contradiction(s) caused by a change to `NH-BREW-PRO`.

## What changed

- Authoritative source: `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:shopify,northstar_home.catalog.products,PROD)`
- Price: 109.00 USD
- Sellable inventory: 3
- Return window: 30 days

## What was wrong

- **Merchant feed advertises a stale price** (critical) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:s3,northstar_home.feeds.google_merchant_feed,PROD)`
  - expected `109.00`, observed `89.00`
  - Shoppers see 89.00 in Shopping ads and free listings, then are charged 109.00 at checkout.
- **Bundle can oversell available inventory** (critical) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:postgres,northstar_home.bundles.bundle_availability,PROD)`
  - expected `3`, observed `5`
  - Up to 2 customers can complete checkout for stock that does not exist, and their orders must be cancelled after payment.
- **Promotion is anchored to a stale price** (high) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:postgres,northstar_home.promotions.promotions_active,PROD)`
  - expected `109.00`, observed `89.00`
  - The advertised sale price of 75.65 is calculated from a price the store no longer charges.
- **AI shopping manifest is stale** (high) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:s3,northstar_home.ai.shopping_manifest,PROD)`
  - expected `{'price': '109.00', 'available': 3}`, observed `{'price': '89.00', 'available': 12}`
  - Third-party shopping agents quote these values directly to shoppers, so the wrong price and stock level are stated as fact before the customer ever reaches the store.
- **Customer-facing asset has no owner in DataHub** (medium) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:s3,northstar_home.ai.shopping_manifest,PROD)`
  - expected `at least one owner`, observed `none`
  - Errors on this surface persist until someone notices, because no team is accountable for it.
- **Storefront return policy contradicts the authoritative policy** (medium) on `urn:li:dataset:(urn:li:dataPlatform:postgres,northstar_home.policy.storefront_policy,PROD)`
  - expected `30`, observed `14`
  - Customers are told they have 14 days to return this item when they actually have 30.

## How it was resolved

Comgu generated a patch from registered remediation templates and validated it: 7 tests passed, 0 failed.

Approved by amir@comgu.site. Comgu never mutates a downstream system without a recorded human approval.

## For whoever comes next

These surfaces project from the authoritative catalog. If you change price, inventory or policy at the source, expect every asset listed above to need re-derivation — pinned values in their configs will not follow automatically.
